meta.name: product-marketing-copywriter
meta.description: 产品营销文案创作技能，支持多品类产品的吸引性营销文案生成，适用于产品推广、品牌营销、销售转化

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为产品生成吸引人的营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为产品撰写有吸引力的营销文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling marketing copy for your products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write attractive marketing copy for your products

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成产品营销文案专家。它能根据你提供的产品信息、目标受众和卖点，生成完整的营销文案（标题、正文、行动号召），也能优化你已有的文案。
howto.when: 当你提出产品营销文案创作或优化需求时触发，例如要求为某产品写推广文案或改进现有文案。

say.text: 帮我为这款智能手表写一段营销文案，目标用户是年轻上班族。
say.note: Claude 会收集产品信息并生成文案。

say.text: 优化这段文案的标题和行动号召：……
say.note: Claude 会分析并改进你的文案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a product marketing copywriter. It can generate complete marketing copy (headline, body, CTA) based on product info, target audience, and unique selling points, and can also optimize existing copy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request product marketing copy creation or optimization, e.g., ask to write promotional copy for a product or improve existing copy.

say_en.text: Write a marketing copy for this smartwatch targeting young office workers.
say_en.note: Claude will collect product info and generate copy.

say_en.text: Optimize the headline and CTA of this copy: ...
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and improve your copy.
